entities.name: Query LECRK-like kinase
observations: 768 aa plant single-pass receptor-like protein with an N-terminal signal peptide, extracellular lectin-containing region, one transmembrane helix, and a cytosolic protein kinase domain.
Pfam detects B_lectin PF01453 at residues 92–168 and PK_Tyr_Ser-Thr/Pkinase domains at residues 523–719.
Sequence is identical across its full length to curated rice LECRK3 reference Q0JEU6 in the retrieved homology analysis.

entities.name: Oryza LECRK3
observations: Curated rice G-type lectin S-receptor-like serine/threonine-protein kinase; EC 2.7.11.1.
Annotated as a single-pass type I membrane protein with extracellular residues 24–464, transmembrane helix 465–485, and cytoplasmic region 486–811.
Protein kinase domain spans residues 521–795; active-site proton acceptor is annotated at residue 645.
Functionally associated with resistance to the brown planthopper Nilaparvata lugens, but this biological role does not define the catalytic chemistry.

entities.name: Protein Ser/Thr phosphorylation
observations: The kinase transfers the gamma phosphate of ATP to a protein serine or threonine hydroxyl: L-seryl-[protein] + ATP = O-phospho-L-seryl-[protein] + ADP + H(+), and/or L-threonyl-[protein] + ATP = O-phospho-L-threonyl-[protein] + ADP + H(+).
The retrieved curated EC annotation is EC 2.7.11.1; Rhea mappings include RHEA:17989 for serine phosphorylation and RHEA:46608 for threonine phosphorylation.
Exact physiological protein substrate and residue specificity are not established by the sequence alone.

entities.name: ATP-binding kinase domain
observations: The cytosolic kinase region contains the canonical Pkinase and PK_Tyr_Ser-Thr Pfam signatures, supporting ATP-dependent protein phosphorylation.
Retrieved annotations include ATP binding (GO:0005524), protein serine kinase activity (GO:0106310), and protein serine/threonine kinase activity (GO:0004674).
